description: Find specific orders across all connected channels. `query` matches an order ID, line-item ID, or SKU (substring). Filter by channel, attribution state, and date range. Money fields are in minor units (paise for INR) — convert to ₹. Use get_order for full detail on one order.

channel.description: Restrict to one channel code (e.g. amazon, flipkart).

query.description: Order ID / line-item ID / SKU to search for.

since.description: ISO date — only orders created on/after this.

until.description: ISO date — only orders created on/before this.

name: search_orders
title: Search orders
